result.title: Explicit Regularization for Flow Matching
result.comment: 40 pages (main text pp. 1-24, references pp. 24-26, appendices A-C pp. 27-40), 4 figures, 11 tables
result.summary: Learning the underlying probability distribution from samples is a core problem in statistics and applied mathematics. Generative models based on diffusion and flow matching learn a velocity field whose flow transports a known distribution to the data distribution. They produce novel, realistic samples, although the empirical learning problem is ill posed near the data distribution. Its minimizer transports the samples onto the training data, and small perturbations of the data change the velocity field strongly near the end of the flow. The observed generalization is often attributed to implicit regularization by the network parameterization, early stopping of the training, and the time integration during sampling. Explicit regularization has advanced the theory and computation of many inverse problems and has recently been proposed to prevent memorization in generative models. With a regularizer on the magnitude of the velocity, however, the field approaches the memorizing velocity unless the regularization parameter grows to infinity fast enough, and it then stays bounded by a constant that is small only for large parameters. We show that penalizing the derivatives of order $k$ of the velocity renders the $D$-dimensional empirical problem well posed uniformly in time if $2k > D$ and the training points are in general position. Our experiments in one and two dimensions discretize the velocity with splines and use direct solvers for the regularized least-squares problems to exclude optimization error. Refining the discretization in space and time changes the error of the Hessian-regularized flows only marginally, whereas without the regularizer the error tends to that of memorization. These flows generalize, with errors comparable to or lower than those of well-tuned kernel density estimates.

AI.brief_summary: 理论分析 flow matching 经验问题在数据附近的不适定性与记忆化倾向，证明当 2k>D 且训练点处于一般位置时惩罚速度场的 k 阶导数可使问题在时间上一致适定，并用一、二维样条离散实验验证正则化流动的误差不随分辨率提升而趋向记忆化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文与视觉推理无直接关系，但其关于学习动力场记忆化与泛化的诊断，以及用高阶导数惩罚约束状态轨迹的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练监督与过度拟合视觉细节的问题提供可供核查的参照。
